name: My views
description: The Codex app's sidebar: New thread, Automations and Skills on top, then your threads under their project folders with how long ago each moved, and a Personal account row at the end.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats: title, state, folder and times.
scopes.workspace:read: Know which workspace is open, to mark its thread.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a thread's workspace when you click it.
scopes.actions:run: Start a thread, open Automations and Skills, and open a thread that has no workspace.
